## Summary of Changes
Please provide a clear and concise summary of the changes proposed in this pull request.

## Related Issues
Fixes #(issue number) or Addresses #(issue number)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] CI / Build tooling

## Quality Gates Checklist
- [ ] Code follows project style guidelines (`uv run ruff check .` and `uv run ruff format --check .`)
- [ ] Type checking passes (`uv run mypy src tests`)
- [ ] All unit and property tests pass (`uv run pytest`)
- [ ] Relevant documentation has been updated (`docs/`, `README.md`)
- [ ] If CLI flags or commands were changed, `uv run python scripts/generate_cli_docs.py` has been executed
